doc.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023

title: Being mistaken for Steve Gadd
summary: A man outside a club on Amsterdam Avenue greeted him as Steve; Parker takes it as a compliment.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: All right. One last Stuff related question, did anybody ever mis-identify you and Steve Gadd?

Often. Often. I was playing a gig, I don’t remember the name of the club, it was on Amsterdam Avenue. It’s not there anymore. And the drums are set up in the window facing the street. And I was playing with somebody —oh that’s bad I can’t remember exactly who I was playing with but we finished a set then I played a little solo and took a break and this guy who had been watching through the window out on the street came into the club finally, you know he had wanted to avoid paying the cover charge. And that’s the first thing he said to me, “Sounding good as ever, Steve.” So I took it as a compliment.
If you sound like Steve Gadd you’re doing all right.
